item.title: Manga's Disaster "Prediction" Might Still Be Affecting Japanese Tourism
item.description: Japan saw a drop in tourism, most specifically from Hong Kong, due to the prediction of a manga creator some people believe to be psychic.

item.title: I Want Your Mother to Be with Me! Is a Laid-back, Slice-of-Life Love Story
item.description: In I Want Your Mother to Be with Me!, Ryo is working part-time while trying to pass his accounting exam and he's in love.
